$comment: Store toolchain requirements that can force an SDK or toolchain move regardless of the SDK trigger. Read by check-sdk-trigger.mjs (rule store-deadline): a requirement in effect that the app does not meet is a FAIL; one that starts later is a notice line. Add an entry when Apple or Google announce one (with its source); never delete one that is in effect.

appStore.rule: apps uploaded to App Store Connect must be built with Xcode 26 or later, using an SDK for iOS 26

play.rule: new apps and app updates must target Android 16 (API level 36) or higher (phones and tablets; Wear OS and Android Automotive OS 35, Android TV and Android XR 34)
